groups.contentHtml:
International Travelling and Working Agency
Name: Sarah Brown
Date of birth: 1988
Address: 21 Waverley Road, Radstone, RD4 6WV
Contact tel. no.:
Notes
•   wants to travel in Europe
•   hopes to travel by
•   interested in working in a
•   recommended to consider an alternative, e.g. work
•   advised to buy a European for travelling
•   given a with accommodation details
•   agreed to take out from the Agency
•   told to use an for contacting people

analyses.content: 当旅行社职员问到出生日期时，你不仅能听到女孩先说了3月30日。
你可能会被职员插话说的“31st”干扰，但这其实是职员自己的生日，不是正确答案。
Date of birth? March the 30th. Oh, I'm the 31st. [laughs] 1988.
面对留电话号码的要求，女孩直接报出了自己的一连串手机数字“0903-775115”。
这是一道比较直接的数字听写题，你只要跟着录音节奏，不漏听、不错记任何一个数字即可得分。
And a contact telephone number, please. Um, I can give you my mobile number. Mm-hmm. 0903-775115. Fine.
当被问及旅行目的地时，女孩给出了非常清晰的回答，她想去北欧（Northern Europe）。
录音紧接着提到了南欧（Southern Europe），但你要注意那是她以前和家人去过的地方，千万别填错。

Now, tell me where you plan to travel to, and I'll see how I can help. Well, I'd like to go to Northern Europe. Have you been there before? No. I know Southern Europe quite well, as I've been there with my family.
女孩提到自己想通过坐火车（train）的方式去旅行，因为这样可以随时在想停的地方下车。
录音里虽然提到了“plane”（飞机），但那是她过去和家人出行的交通方式，不是她这次想要的。
We always went by plane, but now I can choose. I'd like to go by train so I can stop off whenever I want.
关于工作意向，女孩说自己考虑过酒店（hotel）工作，因为这份工作可能包住宿。
题目填空线前面已经有了冠词“a”，所以你只需要填入核心名词“hotel”即可，不要把“work”也填进去。
Now, just as important, what sort of work have you got in mind? Well, I thought about hotel work because then I might get accommodation with the job, and I'd like to work for about half the year.
旅行社职员建议女孩考虑一个备选方案（alternative），并举例说明很多学生喜欢在农场（farm）工作。
只要你牢牢抓住卷面上的“alternative”作为定位信号，在女孩问出“Such as?”（比如呢？）之后，就能立刻抓到正确答案。

Perhaps you should consider an alternative just in case. Such as? Well, lots of students like to work on a farm, and we have lots of requests from people looking for student workers for a few weeks at a time throughout the year.
聊到交通花费时，职员建议最好的选择是办一张欧洲通行证（European pass），这样可以在非高峰期无限次乘车。
录音最开始提到了买单程票（single tickets），但职员马上说这太贵了，你在此处要能够排除掉这个干扰。
Now, travel. Buying single tickets would be expensive, so the best option would be to have a European pass, which would give you unlimited rail travel at off-peak times.
女孩询问有没有青年旅社的相关信息，职员回答说可以给她一本小册子（booklet）。
题目中的“given a”对应了录音里的“give you a”，听到这里直接写下“booklet”即可，千万注意拼写不要漏字母。
Do you have any information about youth hostels which I could use to plan my route? Yes, I'll give you a booklet now, but it's down to you to book your accommodation.
职员明确指出在安排行程前，女孩需要为整个旅程购买保险（insurance），并在解释了保障范围后，女孩同意了这个提议（I'll do that）。  另外，题干中的take out 是一个固定搭配，意思是“办理、购买、投保”。
这道题的对话跨度比较大，你需要跟住职员提出“insurance”的话头，然后耐心等女孩后面表示同意，不能只听一半。

Well, before I make any arrangements for you, you need to have insurance for your entire trip. We can arrange that for you if you like. What does it cover? Any valuable items, jewelry, for example, your money, your mobile, your health, and if you needed to get back home quickly, you'd be covered so you could buy a plane ticket. Right. I'll do that.
女孩原本想自己带电脑去联系家人，但职员认为出门带着电脑不方便，更明智的建议是使用网吧（internet café）。
你可能会听到“laptop”或者“computer”，但这些都是被职员立刻否定的想法，你需要抓取的是职员最终让大家去使用的场所。

I thought I'd take my laptop so I can email and keep in touch with people at home. Hmm. Not a good idea to lug your computer around with you. It's much more sensible to rely on an internet café. That's what we tell people to do. Oh, okay.
